text:
maria (Finance): FYI I received invoice VERTX-2026-0421 for $23,458.90 — PDF attached. Invoice does NOT reference a Redwood PO and approver routing went to #product-dev instead of procurement. Can someone confirm the correct RI PO for Vertex Dedicated? cc @beth

beth (Eng Finance): I can't find RI-PO-2026-0117 or any PO matching that amount in Coupa. Do we even have a PO for Vertex this quarter?

todd (Procurement): We issued RI-PO-2026-0117 for the Vertex reserved pool (monthly commit ~$18k). Vendor appears to have invoiced for a larger amount that includes a surge line. They used their internal ref `VX-INV-5023` on the pdf. Vendor should reference our RI-PO or we need a new PO for the overage.

samir (Platform): Confirming platform saw extra GPU-hours Feb 8–12 during a migration batch. I can produce a usage report with job IDs to justify the surge. Will post CSV shortly.

jen (AP): Per AP policy, we need a PO to pay. I'll place a payment hold in NetSuite and flag the invoice as "Inquiry" until vendor corrects. Please confirm PO or provide procurement approval for a non-PO payment.

invoices-bot: Invoice VERTX-2026-0421 flagged -> reason: missing PO; status updated to PENDING_VENDOR_CLARIFICATION.

beth (Eng Finance): Action items: (1) Todd, ask vendor to reissue invoice referencing RI-PO-2026-0117 (or provide a corrected invoice that breaks out reserve vs surge). (2) Samir, attach usage evidence so AP can validate charges.

todd (Procurement): On it. Message I'll send: "Please reissue with Redwood PO RI-PO-2026-0117 and itemize surge separately, or provide credit note for amount over the committed monthly. Otherwise we must hold payment."

maria (Finance): AP will hold payment until we receive corrected invoice. If vendor doesn't reissue by EOD Friday, we'll escalate to PO exception workflow for one-time approval.

jen (AP): I've set the invoice to HOLD in NetSuite with comment: "awaiting vendor-corrected invoice referencing RI-PO-2026-0117; usage validation required". GL coding suggestion: `platform:ml-serving` — confirm?

samir (Platform): Confirm GL: `platform:ml-serving`. Dropping usage CSV in thread in ~10m: ``job_id,start,end,gpu_hours
job_8891,2026-02-08T03:12Z,2026-02-08T09:20Z,74.5
job_9044,2026-02-10T01:00Z,2026-02-10T07:45Z,62.0``

todd (Procurement): FYI vendor asked if we can accept vendor reference instead of PO on recurring invoices — short answer: no per purchasing policy unless pre-approved. I'll queue a PO-exception request only if vendor can't reissue.

beth (Eng Finance): Agreed — don't make ad-hoc exceptions. Add to procurement exception queue if needed.

(30m later) todd (Procurement): Vendor replied: "Will reissue invoice with RI-PO-2026-0117 and itemized surge line by tomorrow AM."

jen (AP): Thanks — leaving hold in place until corrected invoice arrives, then will process.

maria (Finance): Thanks everyone. Marking this thread as monitored; reopen if vendor misses the promised reissue. :white_check_mark:
